test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 12 Nov 2021 Shift 2
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.**

Hema told her friends that Rose was worried whether she would break her team’s scoring record soon.

options.text: Hema told her friends, “Rose is worried whether she would break her team’s scoring record soon.”
Hema said to her friends, “Rose is worried whether she will break her team’s scoring record soon."
Hema said to her friends, “Rose was worried whether she will break her team’s scoring record soon.”
Her friends said to Hema, “Rose was worried that she would break her team’s scoring record soon.”

solution:
The correct answer is: **Hema said to her friends, “Rose is worried whether she will break her team’s scoring record soon."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The given sentence is in indirect speech and we need to convert it to direct speech.
 
• When we change an indirect speech to direct speech, we must follow these rules:
 
 
• The reported verb 'told' changes to 'said to' in the reporting speech part.
 
• The conjunction 'that' is replaced with inverted commas ("...") to show the direct speech part.
 
• A comma (,) is added after the direct speech part.
 
• The first word of the direct speech is in capital letter.
 
• The helping verb 'was' in the indirect part changes to 'is' in the direct speech part.
 
• The modal "**would**" in the indirect part changes to 'will' in the direct speech part.
 
 

Thus, option 2 is the correct answer.

Hence, direct speech is - *Hema said to her friends, “Rose is worried whether she will break her team’s scoring record soon."*
